paper.title_en: Gravitational Origin of Black Hole Thermodynamic Geometry from Boundary Conditions
paper.abstract_en: In black hole thermodynamics, Hessian metrics change both their signature and their singularities from one statistical ensemble to another. A negative eigenvalue may therefore signal either a physical instability or only a Legendre transformation. We derive this geometry from the bulk action and boundary terms of four-dimensional Euclidean Einstein-Maxwell-anti-de Sitter gravity. In the bulk, the radial symplectic flux pairs the mass and charge with their asymptotic sources, and horizon regularity selects the equilibrium states. At infinity, the boundary terms determine the ensemble polarization by specifying which reservoir parameters are held constant and which conjugate quantities fluctuate. Fixing the temperature and electric potential gives the Ruppeiner metric, whereas adding the Maxwell boundary term fixes the charge and reverses the corresponding metric sign. Tracking the boundary conditions thus separates true stability boundaries from singularities of the Legendre transform. Local holographic counterterms leave the metric unchanged, while mixed electric boundary conditions interpolate between the two ensembles and shift their stability limits.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文从四维欧几里得 Einstein-Maxwell-anti-de Sitter 引力的体作用量与边界项出发，推导黑洞热力学几何（Hessian 度规）的起源，明确区分真实稳定性边界与 Legendre 变换奇点，并把系综极化与边界条件、Maxwell 边界项联系起来。问题具体、推导路线清晰，属于黑洞热力学与全息方法交叉的理论工作；文摘方法陈述明确但未给出定量结果与验证细节，需阅读正文进一步评估。
decision.title_zh: 由边界条件导出黑洞热力学几何的引力起源
decision.abstract_zh: 在黑洞热力学中，Hessian 度规在不同统计系综之间会改变其符号差与奇点。因此，一个负本征值既可能表示物理不稳定性，也可能只是代表一次 Legendre 变换。我们从四维欧几里得 Einstein-Maxwell-anti-de Sitter 引力的体作用量与边界项出发推导这一几何。在体内，径向辛通量将质量与电荷同其渐近源配对，而视界正则性筛选出平衡态。在无穷远处，边界项通过指定哪些储库参数保持不变、哪些共轭量发生涨落，来决定系综极化。固定温度与电势给出 Ruppeiner 度规，而加入 Maxwell 边界项则固定电荷并反转相应的度规符号。因此，追踪边界条件可以把真正的稳定性边界与 Legendre 变换的奇点区分开来。局部全息抵消项不改变度规，而混合电边界条件在两个系综之间插值，并移动它们的稳定性极限。
